items.name: burning-screen
items.title: Burning-Screen
items.description: A page transition that burns the current screen away from the click and reveals the next page.

items.name: agent-draw
items.title: Agent-Draw
items.description: A loader where named cursors draw the page's skeleton live, top to bottom, then the real content fades in.

items.name: brain-txt
items.title: brain.txt
items.description: A brain in the middle of a web of dots that each hold a thought. Hover, click and drag to play with it.

items.name: scratch-me
items.title: Scratch-me
items.description: A promo code under a scratch-off foil. Scratch half and it reveals itself and copies to the clipboard.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password-Strength
items.description: A password field with show/hide that rates the password as AI, AI agent or Human, from three checkpoints.

items.name: framed-upload
items.title: Framed-Upload
items.description: An image upload that hangs the picture in a frame with a soft shadow, like a print on a wall.

items.name: hex-login
items.title: Hex-Login
items.description: A calm login page: your logo inside four thin hexagon rings, Sign in with Google, an email field with a built-in check, and Continue.

items.name: burning-toast
items.title: Burning-toast
items.description: Toasts that stack at the bottom of the screen and burn away when they close: from the X, from the top when time runs out, or where a swipe lets go.
